tasks.subject: Fix F-13858 SHAKE-only PSA_HASH_MAX_SIZE buffers
tasks.description: PSA_HASH_MAX_SIZE derived from PSA_WANT SHA-2/SHA-3 macros ignores SHAKE: WOLFSSL_SHAKE256 build without SHA-512/SHA3-512 exposes 64-byte PSA_ALG_SHAKE256_512 with 32-byte internal buffers (psa_hash_verify, psa_hash_compare, sign/verify message workers). Use a bound covering all accepted backends (max of PSA_HASH_MAX_SIZE and WC_MAX_DIGEST_SIZE) for the scratch buffers.
